ātatāyi:
ātatāyi(n)

ṭhānīya:
ṭhānīya
ṭhāniya mfn. and n., 1. (mfn.) [cf S. sthānīya] (i) standing, having a certain position; — ifc see ucca-, dhuva-; — (ii) being a source or a cause (for); — ifc see āsava- (sv āsava2), kaṅkhā-, domanassa-, dosa- (sv dosa2); — (iii) being a suitable object for; — ifc see karuṇā-, cetiya-; — (iv) taking the place of, acting as; — ifc see kaṇṭaka- (sv kaṇṭaka1), garu- (sv garu2); — 2.
